h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bikaner

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bikaner

items.pText: Bikaner lies in the Thar desert of north-west Rajasthan, known for its sandstone forts, its camel breeding and its sweets and snacks. Summers are extremely hot, winter nights are cold, and fine sand reaches everywhere. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for Bikaner's schools, cantonment colonies, hotels, havelis and parks at our Vasai factory, about 960 km away, and delivers it by road.

Sand is the main maintenance issue in a desert town. It drifts against posts, collects on decks and gets into bearings and springs, where it wears moving parts faster than ordinary dust. The steel and plastic themselves cope well with the heat, as galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts are weather-proof. Planning the site to block wind-blown sand, and a regular cleaning routine, keeps the equipment working for longer.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Keeping sand out of a desert playground

c: Build a low wall or plant a hedge on the side the wind usually comes from. Lay rubber flooring over a firm base, since loose sand under equipment hides stones and gets kicked into moving parts.

Sweep the area daily in windy months, and check merry-go-round bearings and spring rider springs every month. Both carry a 1-year warranty, and our after-sales team supplies spares. For a hotel or heritage property, our

items.q: How do we stop sand damaging playground equipment?
items.a: Block the wind with a wall or hedge, use rubber flooring instead of loose sand, sweep often and check bearings and springs each month. These moving parts are where sand causes wear.

items.q: Do you have playground equipment with a Rajasthani theme?
items.a: Our Funplay Originals range includes Unt Savari, a camel-inspired ride designed by our own team. It suits hotels and heritage properties that want a local touch.

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment to Bikaner?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture at our Vasai factory, about 960 km away, and send the equipment to Bikaner by road. Our team or a Rajasthan dealer installs it.
